test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: K, L, M, N, O and P are six people sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table at a wedding. K is the immediate neighbour of P and is seated second to the right of O. O is seated to the immediate left of M. N is an immediate neighbour of both P and L. Who is seated second to the right of L?
solution: **Given: ** K, L, M, N, O, and P are six people sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table at a wedding. **Solution: ** (1) K is the immediate neighbour of P and is seated second to the right of O.
